QF.id: AIFM CII AIFs in India and Suitability_7

question.text: During an LP marketing roadshow, the CIO of Kailash Capital AIF is asked to quote the current size of the Indian AIF industry. Per the figures cited in Chapter 3 of the NISM XIX-D workbook, as of December 31, 2025, the CUMULATIVE capital commitments raised by all SEBI-registered AIFs (across all three categories) have surpassed approximately what level?

explanation.text: The Logic: The 'Current AIF Market in India' section of Chapter 3 states that capital commitments across SEBI-registered AIFs had surpassed INR 15.74 lakh crore as of December 31, 2025. The workbook also reports 1,771 AIFs were registered with SEBI as of February 11, 2026. The Trap: INR 1.57 lakh crore understates the figure by an order of magnitude. INR 5.74 lakh crore is well below the December 31, 2025 number. INR 157 lakh crore overstates by 10x and would exceed the entire Indian mutual fund AUM. Note: These industry numbers are revised each workbook edition; always quote the date-stamped figure from the latest source.
